description: Count words/characters and compute readability statistics. Operations: "count" — Compute basic text statistics (words, characters, sentences, etc.).; "readability" — Compute readability scores (Flesch, SMOG, Coleman-Liau).; "keywords" — Compute keyword density for the text.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: count: The text to analyze. readability: The text to analyze. keywords: The text to analyze.

operation.description: count — Compute basic text statistics (words, characters, sentences, etc.). readability — Compute readability scores (Flesch, SMOG, Coleman-Liau). keywords — Compute keyword density for the text.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: word-count
title: Word Counter
